decision_description: Phase 4 Gantt and Milestone design completed under the following material interpretive decisions: (1) All six dependency edges inherited from Phase 3 wp_structure.json (T1-02→T2-01, T1-03→T2-01, T1-02→T3-03, T1-03→T3-03, T2-03→T5-02, T3-03→T5-02) were classified as non-strict because their edge_type is 'data_input', not 'finish_to_start' or 'strict_sequence'; no hard temporal ordering was enforced, permitting concurrent task execution within WP bounds. (2) Project duration was fixed at 24 months (European Fellowship maximum) read from Tier 3 selected_call.json (project_duration_months=24, status=Confirmed, host_country=HU). (3) WP bounds were derived from deliverable due_months in wp_structure.json: WP1[1–14], WP2[6–20], WP3[8–24], WP4[1–24], WP5[1–24]. (4) Six milestones were defined with verifiable criteria aligned to task completion months; all six passed the milestone-consistency-check (0 flagged of 6). (5) The synthesised tasks and deliverables recorded in wp_structure.json normalization_issues NI-02 through NI-11 (seed WPs lacked tasks[] and deliverables[] arrays) were accepted as the authoritative Phase 3 output since the Phase 3 gate passed (status=pass, run_id=50ec7164-9a7e-419f-9db2-7b540e077f36) and those items satisfy the CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 3 gate condition.
alternatives_considered: Treating data_input edges as strict finish-to-start constraints, which would have forced sequential scheduling and compressed parallelism; rejected because the edge_type taxonomy in wp_structure.json explicitly distinguishes data_input from finish_to_start, and coercing data_input to strict would contradict the Phase 3 dependency_map semantics.

Using the call-level max_project_duration_months=36 (Global Fellowship ceiling) rather than the operator-confirmed project_duration_months=24; rejected because selected_call.json carries project_duration_months=24 with status=Confirmed (operator-confirmed European Fellowship, intra-EU BG→HU move) which is a higher-authority fact than the call-level ceiling.

Deriving WP bounds from task assignments rather than deliverable due_months; rejected because deliverable due_months are the only structured temporal anchors present in wp_structure.json and represent the Phase 3 gate-passed output.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4 gate condition (all tasks assigned to months; all milestones have verifiable criterion; timeline fits call-specified duration; no critical path dependency unresolved); Tier 3 docs/tier3_project_instantiation/call_binding/selected_call.json (project_duration_months=24, Confirmed, host_country=HU, Confirmed); Tier 4 docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase3_wp_design/wp_structure.json (gate-passed Phase 3 output, run_id=50ec7164-9a7e-419f-9db2-7b540e077f36, status=pass) as the authoritative source of WP structure, task definitions, deliverable due_months, and dependency edge semantics
rationale: The non-strict classification of all dependency edges is the correct interpretation of the Phase 3 dependency_map: the edge_type='data_input' label indicates that a downstream task consumes outputs of an upstream task but does not require the upstream task to be fully completed before the downstream task begins. Enforcing strict finish-to-start ordering on data_input edges would misrepresent the dependency semantics and over-constrain the Gantt. The 24-month duration is operator-confirmed (Confirmed status in selected_call.json) and consistent with European Fellowship rules for an intra-EU move (BG→HU); using 36 months would violate the Tier 3 confirmed fact. WP bounds from deliverable due_months are the only Phase-3-gate-anchored temporal constraints available; all deliverable due_months are ≤24, satisfying the duration constraint. All six milestones have non-empty verifiable_criterion fields and their due_months coincide with or follow the latest task completion month among their depends_on_tasks (milestone-consistency-check: 6/6 passed, 0 flagged). The critical path (T1-02→T3-03→T5-02) is resolved with no unresolved dependency. Phase 4 gate condition is satisfied.
